HolaRise – Youth Community & Social Impact Initiative

A non-profit youth and student community rooted in Hoa Lac, Hanoi — bringing young people together to listen honestly, learn from one another, and act for the common good.

Concept Visual
Hola · Hoa Lac

Rooted in Hoa Lac, Built to Travel Far

“Care is never proven by words alone — it lives in what we actually do together: an honest circle to listen and learn, a cleaner road than yesterday, and a bookshelf placed in children's hands.”

Hola · Together We Rise, Together We Serve
01 · MISSION

Creating transparent, non-profit gatherings and civic projects where young people learn from one another, honor family, care for the environment, and contribute meaningfully to society.

02 · VISION

Building a grounded network of students and young professionals who stay curious, live thoughtfully, and act consistently for their communities — starting in Hoa Lac and reaching far beyond.

Impact Model

Three Pillars: Learn Together, Act Together

View Schedule →→
01 · HolaHeart

Listening & Family

Stage-free circles to talk honestly about family, learn from one another's perspectives, and grow steadier in daily life.

  • Peer dialogues & shared learning
  • Family gratitude & reflection
  • Acoustic evenings for genuine connection
View HolaHeart schedule→→
02 · HolaGreen

Caring for Where We Live

HolaGreen is preparing to launch safe public roadside cleanups around university zones, practicing waste sorting at source and caring for local greenery.

  • Safe public roadside cleanups
  • Source waste sorting & plastic reduction
  • Native greenery stewardship
View HolaGreen schedule→→
03 · HolaConnect

Connection & Community Bookshelves

Outdoor walks connecting students across campuses to broaden perspectives, learn from one another, and build transparent children's bookshelves with local schools.

  • Pine-hill treks & outdoor connection
  • Children's community bookshelves
  • Transparent partnerships with local schools
View HolaConnect schedule→→
Core Values

4 Standards We Practice

01

Listen & Learn

Eye-level circles where every real story brings a perspective worth learning from.

02

Family & Gratitude

Honoring parents, teachers, and the quiet kindness supporting us each day.

03

Honest Action

Less spectacle, real follow-through: meaningful sessions, clean roads, and children's bookshelves.

04

Clear & Transparent

Every schedule, cost, and real outcome is published openly after each project.

Governance & Safeguarding

5 Transparency Principles

Transparency & Privacy →→
  1. 01
    Non-Profit

    Transparent Costs Down to the Last Number

    Events are free to attend; any personal cafe drink or supply cost is stated clearly before you RSVP.

  2. 02
    Peer-Led

    Voluntary & Eye-Level Participation

    HolaHeart circles are peer listening spaces — never clinical therapy. You choose how much to share.

  3. 03
    Independent

    In-Kind First Collaboration

    We prioritize venues, books, saplings, and supplies over ad-hoc cash pools, with zero commercial upsells.

  4. 04
    Verified

    Real Documentation Only

    We only publish verified photos and field counts; upcoming tracks are clearly labeled as preparing to launch.

  5. 05
    Privacy

    Dignity-First Media & Data Protection

    No exploitative photos, strict minor consent rules, and minimal data collection under Vietnam Decree 13/2023/ND-CP.

Global Alignment

Aligned with 6 UN Sustainable Development Goals

SDG 3

Good Health & Well-Being

Peer-listening circles supporting student emotional balance and resilience.

SDG 4

Quality Education

Practical life-skills dialogues, reading hours, and children's community bookshelves.

SDG 11

Sustainable Communities

Connecting university students, young professionals, international guests, and local residents.

SDG 13

Climate Action

Reducing single-use plastics and sorting recyclable waste at source.

SDG 15

Life on Land

Keeping safe public green routes clean and caring for native flora.

SDG 17

Partnerships for the Goals

Transparent, non-commercial alliances with universities, student clubs, cultural venues, and NGOs.
